team.name: Sheilia Royal
team.title: Agency Principal / Licensed Agent
team.bio: Sheilia leads The Way Agency with a mission to make insurance accessible and personal. She oversees all commercial and personal lines and brings two decades of experience helping Kentucky businesses and families protect what matters most.

team.name: Audrey Lillpop
team.title: Licensed Agent
team.bio: Audrey helps families across Kentucky find the right home and auto coverage. She is known for taking time to explain options in plain language and making sure clients understand exactly what they are buying.

team.name: Kelly McCallister
team.title: Client Care Specialist
team.bio: Kelly specializes in commercial insurance for contractors, manufacturers, and small businesses across the tri-state area. She understands the unique risks businesses face and works to build coverage programs that protect without overpaying.

team.name: Jill Boone
team.title: Licensed Agent
team.bio: Jill focuses on life and health insurance, helping individuals and families navigate Medicare, health coverage options, and life insurance planning. She brings a patient, detail-oriented approach to every client conversation.
